name: Landmarks Berhad
overview: 2026年，Landmarks Berhad 通过间接全资子公司 Tiara Gateway Pte Ltd 拟以 RM4.48 million 收购 Mendol Investments Pte Ltd 的 5.10% 股权，对价以发行 Landmarks 新股支付。公司未公告其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Landmarks Berhad, through its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Tiara Gateway Pte Ltd, proposed to acquire a 5.10% equity interest in Mendol Investments Pte Ltd for RM4.48 million, to be satisfied via the issuance of new Landmarks shares. No other expansion, reduction, or contract events were announced for the other business segments.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 集团层面公告拟通过发行新股收购 Mendol Investments Pte Ltd 的 5.10% 股权。
segments.note_en: At the group level, a proposed acquisition of a 5.10% equity interest in Mendol Investments Pte Ltd was announced, to be satisfied via the issuance of new shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就拟收购事项向 Bursa Securities 提交了代价股份的上市及报价申请。
actions.text_en: The Company submitted an application to Bursa Securities for the listing of and quotation for the consideration shares to be issued pursuant to the proposed acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Tiara Gateway Pte Ltd（公司间接全资子公司）于2026年10月7日与卖方签订股份出售协议，拟以 RM4.48 million 收购 Mendol Investments Pte Ltd 的 248,288 股普通股（占 5.10% 股权），对价通过发行 Landmarks 新股支付。
